hardRules.rule: Never merge; user approves every merge and every idea.
Ship dev before/after local tests (md+pdf) and QA previous-vs-current with screenshots (md+pdf) before merge.
Append-only hash-chained ticket_events; never rewrite history.
Points Fibonacci 1/2/3/5/8/13; day estimates ceil up to nearest Fib (4 days=5).
Builder owns flow/path; backup only if owner OFF/over WIP/reassigned; log handoff.
Dependency gate: A E2E-tests B whole implementation before B awaiting_merge.
HTML+image mocks for every UI state; PO/SM review then user approval before develop.
FE/BE changes need api_contract + contract_test before merge.
Ideas: research → CEO/CFO comment validation → versioned revisions → user Approve/Decline.
Red/blue findings become tickets; network egress denied by default; only an explicit local allowlist; strip secrets from red runtime.
Load only ticket, contract, owned paths; summaries/diffs; never whole repo.
Never print secrets, tokens, or credentials.
